name: EMA crossover
description: Classic trend following: ride the trend while the fast average is above the slow one.

about.how_it_works: When the 20-bar EMA crosses above the 50-bar EMA, recent prices are rising faster than the longer-term average, which often marks the start of a trend. The trade stays open until the averages cross back.
about.works_best: Long, clean trends, like most of a crypto bull market.
about.fails_when: Prices chop sideways: the averages cross back and forth and each crossover is a small loss. It also enters late, after part of the move has already happened.
